static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q "flutter-version: '3.47.x'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. Simple approach: - bodyForRender = body with leading title-h1 line removed. - html = renderMarkdown(bodyForRender) - if cover != null: if body contained '](' + cover → html = html.replaceFirst('<p><img src="../posts/$cover"', '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover"') and remove trailing '</p>'... messy. Alternative: always strip the leading cover-image line from the md before render, then always emit `<img class="post-cover">`. If body has cover elsewhere (not first), it renders inline. The post's first line after frontmatter is exactly the cover image. Implement: - remove leading `# <title>` line (if matches title). - remove leading `![...](cover)` line (if equals cover) → set flag → emit post-cover img. That's clean and deterministic. 2. `style="text-align: "` with empty align — bug: `alignFor` returns '' when null and cell() checks `align != null`. In `_renderTable` I pass `alignFor(c)` which returns String ('' or value) but cell expects String? — '' is not null → emits `text-align: `. Fix: alignFor returns String? — change signature: `String? alignFor(int col) => col < aligns.length ? aligns[col] : null;` 3. `'` escaping of apostrophes in text — fine (valid HTML). 4. Two-space/indent quirk: `$meta$bodyHtml </article>` — bodyHtml lines start at col 0; fine. 5. Duplicate h1 also in docs pages? DocsPage body drops the first H1 — good. Also table `**Total**` cell renders `<strong>` inside td — good. Fix the builder: - In renderBlogPostPage: preprocess body: split lines; drop leading blank lines; if first line is `# <title-ish>` → drop; if first non-empty line is `![...](<cover>)` → drop and forceCover=true. Then html = renderMarkdown. Cover img emitted when `cover != null && (forcedCover || !body.includes...)` — after stripping, always emit post-cover when cover != null and we stripped it; if not stripped (cover not in body), emit post-cover too (post.html behavior). So: emit post-cover whenever cover != null and it was the leading image or absent from body; if present elsewhere in body, still emit post-cover? post.html: adds cover only if body does NOT include it. Post-strip: body no longer includes it as leading; but my strip only handles leading. Rule: stripped → emit post-cover. Not stripped but body contains cover elsewhere → don't duplicate, body renders it. Absent → emit post-cover. Let me restructure: ```dart var body = p.body.trimLeft(); final lines = body.split('\n'); var idx = 0; while (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim().isEmpty) idx++; var coverFromBody = false; if (idx < lines.length && _heading matches && plainText(group2) == plainText(title)) idx++; if (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim() == '![${...}]($cover)') { coverFromBody = true; idx++; } body = lines.sublist(idx).join('\n').trimLeft(); ``` Compare heading text: `RegExp(r'^#\s+(.+)$')` firstMatch(lines[idx].trim()) → plainText(h.group(1)) == plainText(p.title)? plainText strips markers; title has `(~$20k)` — plainText leaves it. OK compare plainText both sides. Cover image line match: `RegExp(r'^!\[[^\]]*\]\(' + RegExp.escape(cover) + r'\)\s*$')`. Then in template: `${cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')) ? '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover" alt="$title">' : ''}` — after strip, if coverFromBody, body doesn't contain it anymore... unless duplicated. Simplify: emit post-cover iff cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')). Same as before but with strip. Then body markdown render — remove the old h1/cover naturally. Also meta date: fine. Fix alignFor now. Also check: in `_renderTable`, `alignFor` used `aligns[col] != null ? aligns[col]! : ''` — replace with nullable.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

messages.preview: Two bugs to fix: duplicate `<h1>`/cover (post body has its own) and empty `text-align` in tables.

blocks.text:
Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. #!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. Simple approach: - bodyForRender = body with leading title-h1 line removed. - html = renderMarkdown(bodyForRender) - if cover != null: if body contained '](' + cover → html = html.replaceFirst('<p><img src="../posts/$cover"', '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover"') and remove trailing '</p>'... messy. Alternative: always strip the leading cover-image line from the md before render, then always emit `<img class="post-cover">`. If body has cover elsewhere (not first), it renders inline. The post's first line after frontmatter is exactly the cover image. Implement: - remove leading `# <title>` line (if matches title). - remove leading `![...](cover)` line (if equals cover) → set flag → emit post-cover img. That's clean and deterministic. 2. `style="text-align: "` with empty align — bug: `alignFor` returns '' when null and cell() checks `align != null`. In `_renderTable` I pass `alignFor(c)` which returns String ('' or value) but cell expects String? — '' is not null → emits `text-align: `. Fix: alignFor returns String? — change signature: `String? alignFor(int col) => col < aligns.length ? aligns[col] : null;` 3. `'` escaping of apostrophes in text — fine (valid HTML). 4. Two-space/indent quirk: `$meta$bodyHtml </article>` — bodyHtml lines start at col 0; fine. 5. Duplicate h1 also in docs pages? DocsPage body drops the first H1 — good. Also table `**Total**` cell renders `<strong>` inside td — good. Fix the builder: - In renderBlogPostPage: preprocess body: split lines; drop leading blank lines; if first line is `# <title-ish>` → drop; if first non-empty line is `![...](<cover>)` → drop and forceCover=true. Then html = renderMarkdown. Cover img emitted when `cover != null && (forcedCover || !body.includes...)` — after stripping, always emit post-cover when cover != null and we stripped it; if not stripped (cover not in body), emit post-cover too (post.html behavior). So: emit post-cover whenever cover != null and it was the leading image or absent from body; if present elsewhere in body, still emit post-cover? post.html: adds cover only if body does NOT include it. Post-strip: body no longer includes it as leading; but my strip only handles leading. Rule: stripped → emit post-cover. Not stripped but body contains cover elsewhere → don't duplicate, body renders it. Absent → emit post-cover. Let me restructure: ```dart var body = p.body.trimLeft(); final lines = body.split('\n'); var idx = 0; while (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim().isEmpty) idx++; var coverFromBody = false; if (idx < lines.length && _heading matches && plainText(group2) == plainText(title)) idx++; if (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim() == '![${...}]($cover)') { coverFromBody = true; idx++; } body = lines.sublist(idx).join('\n').trimLeft(); ``` Compare heading text: `RegExp(r'^#\s+(.+)$')` firstMatch(lines[idx].trim()) → plainText(h.group(1)) == plainText(p.title)? plainText strips markers; title has `(~$20k)` — plainText leaves it. OK compare plainText both sides. Cover image line match: `RegExp(r'^!\[[^\]]*\]\(' + RegExp.escape(cover) + r'\)\s*$')`. Then in template: `${cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')) ? '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover" alt="$title">' : ''}` — after strip, if coverFromBody, body doesn't contain it anymore... unless duplicated. Simplify: emit post-cover iff cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')). Same as before but with strip. Then body markdown render — remove the old h1/cover naturally. Also meta date: fine. Fix alignFor now. Also check: in `_renderTable`, `alignFor` used `aligns[col] != null ? aligns[col]! : ''` — replace with nullable.

blocks.text:
test-core:
    # Always runs (no job-level path gate): a path-filtered matrix skip
    # posts a check-run with the LITERAL unrendered name — the required
    # contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. Simple approach: - bodyForRender = body with leading title-h1 line removed. - html = renderMarkdown(bodyForRender) - if cover != null: if body contained '](' + cover → html = html.replaceFirst('<p><img src="../posts/$cover"', '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover"') and remove trailing '</p>'... messy. Alternative: always strip the leading cover-image line from the md before render, then always emit `<img class="post-cover">`. If body has cover elsewhere (not first), it renders inline. The post's first line after frontmatter is exactly the cover image. Implement: - remove leading `# <title>` line (if matches title). - remove leading `![...](cover)` line (if equals cover) → set flag → emit post-cover img. That's clean and deterministic. 2. `style="text-align: "` with empty align — bug: `alignFor` returns '' when null and cell() checks `align != null`. In `_renderTable` I pass `alignFor(c)` which returns String ('' or value) but cell expects String? — '' is not null → emits `text-align: `. Fix: alignFor returns String? — change signature: `String? alignFor(int col) => col < aligns.length ? aligns[col] : null;` 3. `'` escaping of apostrophes in text — fine (valid HTML). 4. Two-space/indent quirk: `$meta$bodyHtml </article>` — bodyHtml lines start at col 0; fine. 5. Duplicate h1 also in docs pages? DocsPage body drops the first H1 — good. Also table `**Total**` cell renders `<strong>` inside td — good. Fix the builder: - In renderBlogPostPage: preprocess body: split lines; drop leading blank lines; if first line is `# <title-ish>` → drop; if first non-empty line is `![...](<cover>)` → drop and forceCover=true. Then html = renderMarkdown. Cover img emitted when `cover != null && (forcedCover || !body.includes...)` — after stripping, always emit post-cover when cover != null and we stripped it; if not stripped (cover not in body), emit post-cover too (post.html behavior). So: emit post-cover whenever cover != null and it was the leading image or absent from body; if present elsewhere in body, still emit post-cover? post.html: adds cover only if body does NOT include it. Post-strip: body no longer includes it as leading; but my strip only handles leading. Rule: stripped → emit post-cover. Not stripped but body contains cover elsewhere → don't duplicate, body renders it. Absent → emit post-cover. Let me restructure: ```dart var body = p.body.trimLeft(); final lines = body.split('\n'); var idx = 0; while (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim().isEmpty) idx++; var coverFromBody = false; if (idx < lines.length && _heading matches && plainText(group2) == plainText(title)) idx++; if (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim() == '![${...}]($cover)') { coverFromBody = true; idx++; } body = lines.sublist(idx).join('\n').trimLeft(); ``` Compare heading text: `RegExp(r'^#\s+(.+)$')` firstMatch(lines[idx].trim()) → plainText(h.group(1)) == plainText(p.title)? plainText strips markers; title has `(~$20k)` — plainText leaves it. OK compare plainText both sides. Cover image line match: `RegExp(r'^!\[[^\]]*\]\(' + RegExp.escape(cover) + r'\)\s*$')`. Then in template: `${cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')) ? '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover" alt="$title">' : ''}` — after strip, if coverFromBody, body doesn't contain it anymore... unless duplicated. Simplify: emit post-cover iff cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')). Same as before but with strip. Then body markdown render — remove the old h1/cover naturally. Also meta date: fine. Fix alignFor now. Also check: in `_renderTable`, `alignFor` used `aligns[col] != null ? aligns[col]! : ''` — replace with nullable.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

I'll write a throwaway script in /tmp and run it. Indentation: JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ') produces 2-space indent matching existing style. Key order: Dart maps preserve insertion order; JSON parse preserves order too (json.decode returns LinkedHashMap with source order).

Works, but inner nodes kept their `"@context": "https://schema.org"` keys — redundant inside a @graph (harmless but sloppy; schema.org validators tolerate it, but cleaner to strip). Also array formatting: JsonEncoder.withIndent puts each element on its own line — acceptable but verbose for sameAs arrays of 1-2 items. Fine.

Let me strip the nested @context keys from graph nodes (except top). Quick tweak: in the transform, remove '@context' from each node. Also compact arrays? Leave. Re-run: but the transform already consumed the 3-block format. Easier: small sed-like edit via dart one-liner to remove the two `"@context": "https://schema.org",` lines that are inside graph nodes (lines 71-ish and the FAQPage one). They appear at known indentation (4 spaces). Lines: `    {` followed by `      "@context": "https://schema.org",`. Use python or dart to remove lines matching `^      "@context": "https://schema.org",$` — the top-level one has 2-space indent `  "@context"`. Let me do it.

EOF

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

messages.preview: Two bugs to fix: duplicate `<h1>`/cover (post body has its own) and empty `text-align` in tables.

blocks.text:
Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. Simple approach: - bodyForRender = body with leading title-h1 line removed. - html = renderMarkdown(bodyForRender) - if cover != null: if body contained '](' + cover → html = html.replaceFirst('<p><img src="../posts/$cover"', '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover"') and remove trailing '</p>'... messy. Alternative: always strip the leading cover-image line from the md before render, then always emit `<img class="post-cover">`. If body has cover elsewhere (not first), it renders inline. The post's first line after frontmatter is exactly the cover image. Implement: - remove leading `# <title>` line (if matches title). - remove leading `![...](cover)` line (if equals cover) → set flag → emit post-cover img. That's clean and deterministic. 2. `style="text-align: "` with empty align — bug: `alignFor` returns '' when null and cell() checks `align != null`. In `_renderTable` I pass `alignFor(c)` which returns String ('' or value) but cell expects String? — '' is not null → emits `text-align: `. Fix: alignFor returns String? — change signature: `String? alignFor(int col) => col < aligns.length ? aligns[col] : null;` 3. `'` escaping of apostrophes in text — fine (valid HTML). 4. Two-space/indent quirk: `$meta$bodyHtml </article>` — bodyHtml lines start at col 0; fine. 5. Duplicate h1 also in docs pages? DocsPage body drops the first H1 — good. Also table `**Total**` cell renders `<strong>` inside td — good. Fix the builder: - In renderBlogPostPage: preprocess body: split lines; drop leading blank lines; if first line is `# <title-ish>` → drop; if first non-empty line is `![...](<cover>)` → drop and forceCover=true. test-core:
    # Always runs (no job-level path gate): a path-filtered matrix skip
    # posts a check-run with the LITERAL unrendered name — the required
    # contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0

          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}

with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage
          test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart
          test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (retention 7d so
      # a quiet week never starves it into the file-count fallback).
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer scenarios, PTY
  # harness, no secrets, no network) run per-PR whenever test/integration/**

  # discovered only at tag time) becomes a red PR at the commit that broke

  # provider-smoke job; perf has its own #303 trajectory gate; browser-ext
  # its own workflow. `pty` marks child-agent-spawn tests whose second
  # process boot is unbounded under runner load (issue #553, red twice on
  # this leg) — they stay in nightly's pty-integration job.

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║

# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k

messages.preview: Two bugs to fix: duplicate `<h1>`/cover (post body has its own) and empty `text-align` in tables.

blocks.text:
Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. Simple approach: - bodyForRender = body with leading title-h1 line removed. - html = renderMarkdown(bodyForRender) - if cover != null: if body contained '](' + cover → html = html.replaceFirst('<p><img src="../posts/$cover"', '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover"') and remove trailing '</p>'... messy. Alternative: always strip the leading cover-image line from the md before render, then always emit `<img class="post-cover">`. If body has cover elsewhere (not first), it renders inline. The post's first line after frontmatter is exactly the cover image. Implement: - remove leading `# <title>` line (if matches title). - remove leading `![...](cover)` line (if equals cover) → set flag → emit post-cover img. That's clean and deterministic. 2. `style="text-align: "` with empty align — bug: `alignFor` returns '' when null and cell() checks `align != null`. In `_renderTable` I pass `alignFor(c)` which returns String ('' or value) but cell expects String? — '' is not null → emits `text-align: `. Fix: alignFor returns String? — change signature: `String? alignFor(int col) => col < aligns.length ? aligns[col] : null;` 3. `'` escaping of apostrophes in text — fine (valid HTML). 4. Two-space/indent quirk: `$meta$bodyHtml </article>` — bodyHtml lines start at col 0; fine. 5. Duplicate h1 also in docs pages? DocsPage body drops the first H1 — good. Also table `**Total**` cell renders `<strong>` inside td — good. Fix the builder: - In renderBlogPostPage: preprocess body: split lines; drop leading blank lines; if first line is `# <title-ish>` → drop; if first non-empty line is `![...](<cover>)` → drop and forceCover=true. Then html = renderMarkdown. Cover img emitted when `cover != null && (forcedCover || !body.includes...)` — after stripping, always emit post-cover when cover != null and we stripped it; if not stripped (cover not in body), emit post-cover too (post.html behavior). So: emit post-cover whenever cover != null and it was the leading image or absent from body; if present elsewhere in body, still emit post-cover? post.html: adds cover only if body does NOT include it. Post-strip: body no longer includes it as leading; but my strip only handles leading. Rule: stripped → emit post-cover. Not stripped but body contains cover elsewhere → don't duplicate, body renders it. Absent → emit post-cover. Let me restructure: ```dart var body = p.body.trimLeft(); final lines = body.split('\n'); var idx = 0; while (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim().isEmpty) idx++; var coverFromBody = false; if (idx < lines.length && _heading matches && plainText(group2) == plainText(title)) idx++; if (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim() == '![${...}]($cover)') { coverFromBody = true; idx++; } body = lines.sublist(idx).join('\n').trimLeft(); ``` Compare heading text: `RegExp(r'^#\s+(.+)$')` firstMatch(lines[idx].trim()) → plainText(h.group(1)) == plainText(p.title)? plainText strips markers; title has `(~$20k)` — plainText leaves it. OK compare plainText both sides. Cover image line match: `RegExp(r'^!\[[^\]]*\]\(' + RegExp.escape(cover) + r'\)\s*$')`. Then in template: `${cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')) ? '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover" alt="$title">' : ''}` — after strip, if coverFromBody, body doesn't contain it anymore... unless duplicated. Simplify: emit post-cover iff cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')). Same as before but with strip. Then body markdown render — remove the old h1/cover naturally. Also meta date: fine. Fix alignFor now. Also check: in `_renderTable`, `alignFor` used `aligns[col] != null ? aligns[col]! : ''` — replace with nullable.
Two bugs to fix: duplicate `<h1>`/cover (post body has its own) and empty `text-align` in tables.

The H1 strip didn't work — still a duplicate `<h1>` in body. Why? plainText comparison: title = "We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?`. plainText strips `[`*_~#>]` — the `~` in `(~$20k)` gets stripped! plainText removes `~` chars → "($20k)" vs title plainText also strips → both stripped equally. Wait both sides go through plainText... title has `(~$20k)` → plainText → `($20k)`; h1 same → equal. Hmm should match.

Wait — maybe the first line isn't the h1. Body after stripFrontmatter: the md begins with a blank line, then `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)`, then blank, then `# title`. So order: image FIRST, then h1! My code checks h1 first, then image. The first non-empty line is the image; h1 check fails on the image line; then cover-image check: start points at image line → matches → start++ → then the `# title` line remains in body.

Fix: handle sequence: loop — skip blanks; if line is cover image (and cover != null and not yet stripped) → strip; else if h1 == title → strip; else stop. Both, in either order.

Tool availability (issue #19) decides, per tool id, whether the model sees a tool at all: a tools: config section stacks four scopes — global, project, session, runtime — over the host's hard capability floor, the deepest scope that mentions a tool wins, and a live gate applies the merged decision. Disabling a tool unregisters it (the prompt no longer offers it) and a late call answers a tombstone note instead of executing. Config can only turn a present tool OFF: a tool the platform cannot provide stays off no matter what any scope asks. Load modes (issue #680) are the orthogonal axis — how much of the ENABLED set is loaded into the schema at boot (see Load modes below).

A full example

# ~/.fah/config.yaml — GLOBAL scope: every project on this machine.
tools:
  web_search: false
  mcp:
    fs: false                  # per-server granularity (mcp:<server>)

# <project>/.fah/config.yaml — PROJECT scope: travels with the repo.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400

blocks.text:
Issues found: 1. Duplicate `

`: the body md already starts with `# ` (the post md has its own H1), and my template adds `<h1>$title</h1>`. Also the cover image: body includes `![...](assets/40b-cover.png)` → rendered as `<p><img ...></p>` — post.html renders `.post-cover` class and skips if body includes it. Fix: drop the leading H1 from the body if it equals the title (like docs), and handle cover: if body includes the cover image, the rendered img should get class post-cover... simplest: in renderBlogPostPage, remove the leading `# <title>` line from body; for the cover, leave the body's own `<p><img></p>` (acceptable) or convert first image to post-cover class. Better: strip leading image paragraph and emit `<img class="post-cover">` when body includes cover (mirror post.html logic: `if (meta.cover && !body.includes('](' + cover))` → add cover img; else body renders it inline). For class, I can post-process: if body contains cover image, replace the first `<p><img src="../posts/$cover"` with `<img class="post-cover" ...`. Simple approach: - bodyForRender = body with leading title-h1 line removed. - html = renderMarkdown(bodyForRender) - if cover != null: if body contained '](' + cover → html = html.replaceFirst('<p><img src="../posts/$cover"', '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover"') and remove trailing '</p>'... messy. Alternative: always strip the leading cover-image line from the md before render, then always emit `<img class="post-cover">`. If body has cover elsewhere (not first), it renders inline. The post's first line after frontmatter is exactly the cover image. Implement: - remove leading `# <title>` line (if matches title). - remove leading `![...](cover)` line (if equals cover) → set flag → emit post-cover img. That's clean and deterministic. 2. `style="text-align: "` with empty align — bug: `alignFor` returns '' when null and cell() checks `align != null`. In `_renderTable` I pass `alignFor(c)` which returns String ('' or value) but cell expects String? — '' is not null → emits `text-align: `. Fix: alignFor returns String? — change signature: `String? alignFor(int col) => col < aligns.length ? aligns[col] : null;` 3. `'` escaping of apostrophes in text — fine (valid HTML). 4. Two-space/indent quirk: `$meta$bodyHtml </article>` — bodyHtml lines start at col 0; fine. 5. Duplicate h1 also in docs pages? DocsPage body drops the first H1 — good. Also table `**Total**` cell renders `<strong>` inside td — good. Fix the builder: - In renderBlogPostPage: preprocess body: split lines; drop leading blank lines; if first line is `# <title-ish>` → drop; if first non-empty line is `![...](<cover>)` → drop and forceCover=true. Then html = renderMarkdown. Cover img emitted when `cover != null && (forcedCover || !body.includes...)` — after stripping, always emit post-cover when cover != null and we stripped it; if not stripped (cover not in body), emit post-cover too (post.html behavior). So: emit post-cover whenever cover != null and it was the leading image or absent from body; if present elsewhere in body, still emit post-cover? post.html: adds cover only if body does NOT include it. Post-strip: body no longer includes it as leading; but my strip only handles leading. Rule: stripped → emit post-cover. Not stripped but body contains cover elsewhere → don't duplicate, body renders it. Absent → emit post-cover. Let me restructure: ```dart var body = p.body.trimLeft(); final lines = body.split('\n'); var idx = 0; while (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim().isEmpty) idx++; var coverFromBody = false; if (idx < lines.length && _heading matches && plainText(group2) == plainText(title)) idx++; if (idx < lines.length && lines[idx].trim() == '![${...}]($cover)') { coverFromBody = true; idx++; } body = lines.sublist(idx).join('\n').trimLeft(); ``` Compare heading text: `RegExp(r'^#\s+(.+)$')` firstMatch(lines[idx].trim()) → plainText(h.group(1)) == plainText(p.title)? plainText strips markers; title has `(~$20k)` — plainText leaves it. OK compare plainText both sides. Cover image line match: `RegExp(r'^!\[[^\]]*\]\(' + RegExp.escape(cover) + r'\)\s*$')`. Then in template: `${cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')) ? '<img class="post-cover" src="../posts/$cover" alt="$title">' : ''}` — after strip, if coverFromBody, body doesn't contain it anymore... unless duplicated. Simplify: emit post-cover iff cover != null && (coverFromBody || !body.contains(']($cover)')). Same as before but with strip. Then body markdown render — remove the old h1/cover naturally. Also meta date: fine. Fix alignFor now. Also check: in `_renderTable`, `alignFor` used `aligns[col] != null ? aligns[col]! : ''` — replace with nullable.

The first non-empty line is the image; h1 check fails on the image line; then cover-image check: start points at image line → matches → start++ → then the `# title` line remains in body.

Updated 2026-10-10 · IstiN

Tool availability (issue #19) decides, per tool id, whether the model sees a tool at all: a tools: config section stacks four scopes — global, project, session, runtime — over the host's hard capability floor, the deepest scope that mentions a tool wins, and a live gate applies the merged decision. Disabling a tool unregisters it (the prompt no longer offers it) and a late call answers a tombstone note instead of executing. Config can only turn a present tool OFF: a tool the platform cannot provide stays off no matter what any scope asks. Load modes (issue #680) are the orthogonal axis — how much of the ENABLED set is loaded into the schema at boot (see Load modes below).

A full example

# ~/.fah/config.yaml — GLOBAL scope: every project on this machine.
tools:
  web_search: false
  mcp:
    fs: false                  # per-server granularity (mcp:<server>)

# <project>/.fah/config.yaml — PROJECT scope: travels with the repo.
tools:
====

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

.git/hooks/pre-merge-commit.sample:12:        exec "$GIT_DIR/hooks/pre-commit"

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

2026-09-20 · Uladimir Klyshevich · also on LinkedIn ↗

We burned 40 billion tokens (~$20k) building a harness. Am I crazy?

Today is the day when everyone can build a mobile app directly on their mobile device. It's finally approved by Apple and available in the App Store. Let me tell you a story about it.

40,000,000,000 tokens. 3 months of work. Zero lines of code written by a human.

That is what building >_Fa — my open-source agent harness in Dart — has cost so far. Star the repo and continue reading :). Try it in web https://fa1.dev.

When people hear the number, they hear a fuckup. Forty billion tokens sounds like setting money on fire.

So let's count the money first. Everyone loves counting other people's money.

The bill

The workload ran on the cheapest models that can still do the job — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash — routed per task. At straight API prices, the mix looks like this:

Token typeVolume~Rate~Cost
Cached reads~24B$0.15 / 1M~$3,600
Fresh input~14B$0.60 / 1M~$8,400
Output~2B$2.50 / 1M~$5,000
Total40B≈ $17–20k
